title: Cells and selection
summary: Learn what a cell is and how it is named, select a range of cells, and type your first data into a worksheet.
intro:
Everything you type in Excel is stored in a cell. Cells sit in columns labelled with letters (A, B, C…) and rows numbered 1, 2, 3… So a cell's name is its column letter followed by its row number, such as `C3`.

In this lesson you pick a cell by clicking or with the arrow keys, jump to a cell by typing its name in the Name Box, select a range of neighbouring cells, and type your first data.

faq.q: What is the difference between a cell and a range?
faq.a: A cell is a single box such as `B2`. A range is a block of neighbouring cells, written as the first and last cell with a colon between them, such as `A2:A5`.

faq.q: Why is a cell name a letter and then a number?
faq.a: The letter gives the column and the number gives the row, so the name points to exactly one place on the worksheet.

click-a-cell.prompt: Each box on an Excel worksheet is a cell. A cell's name is its column letter followed by its row number. Click cell `C3`, which holds Youssef's city, then press Enter or Check.
click-a-cell.hint: Find the letter C at the top of the columns, then go down to row 3.
click-a-cell.explain: Cell `C3` is in column C and row 3.

use-the-name-box.prompt: The Name Box shows the name of the selected cell, and you can type in it to jump somewhere. Type `D5` in the Name Box and press Enter, then press Enter again to check.
use-the-name-box.hint: The Name Box is the small box above column A, to the left of the formula bar.

select-a-range.prompt: A block of neighbouring cells is a range, written as the first and last cell with a colon between them: `A2:A5`. Select all the employee names by dragging, or by holding Shift and using the arrow keys, then press Enter.
select-a-range.hint: Start at `A2` and drag down to `A5`. The Name Box should show `A2:A5`.

type-a-name.prompt: A new employee called Huda has joined the team. Select cell `A6`, type the name Huda, then press Enter.
type-a-name.hint: Typing into a selected cell replaces what was there. Press Enter to confirm.

type-a-number.prompt: Huda has 3 years of experience. Type the number 3 in cell `D6`, then press Enter.
type-a-number.hint: Type the digit 3, then press Enter to confirm.

name-that-cell.prompt: What is the name of the cell in column B and row 4?
name-that-cell.hint: The column letter comes first, then the row number.
